issues.quote: revenue rising 32.2% to $96.8 billion from $81.5 billion
issues.problem: Going from $81.5B to $96.8B is about 18.8% growth, not 32.2%.

issues.quote: Profitability kept pace, as net income grew 19.4% to $15.0 billion
issues.problem: The net income figures are right, but the framing is misleading. FY2023 net income included a one-time, non-cash tax benefit of about $5.9B from releasing a valuation allowance, and operating income fell. That tax item largely explains the gap with operating cash flow.

data.summary: All the dollar figures are correct, but revenue growth is misstated as 32.2% when it was about 18.8%. The earnings commentary also leaves out the roughly $5.9B one-time tax benefit inside FY2023 net income.
